metadata.method: Manual narrative review; conservative counting of people explicitly described as injured or reporting injury symptoms.

definitions.minimum: Number of people explicitly described with an injury or symptom, including allegations. Null means narrative does not establish this count; null does not mean no injury.
definitions.exact: Narrative explicitly identifies this many injured people. Exact refers to people described, not a certified complete casualty count for the crash.
definitions.minimum_precision: Narrative explicitly says injured passengers in the plural without a number, yielding a conservative minimum of two.
definitions.unresolved: Narrative does not explicitly identify a person with injury/symptoms despite an injury severity code. Hospital transport alone is not counted as explicit injury.
definitions.evidence: An excerpt of at most 25 words from the narrative, except severity-only records where this is the exact structured severity field.
definitions.responsibilityNote: Factual summary of the reporting entity's account, not an independent fault determination.

reviewNotes: All 64 injury narratives were manually read in full. Counts were not generated by regex.
All reviewed incidents occurred January through June 2026. The source CSV receipt cutoff is July 15, 2026.
The exact counts sum to 54 people in 47 reports. Twelve plural-only reports describe at least 24 more people. Five further injury-coded reports have unresolved explicit narrative counts.
References to unbelted passengers, additional passengers present, and the boilerplate hospital-transport criterion were not treated as additional injured people.
30270-14075 has two people boarding, but only one is reported injured.
30270-15174 repeats the same two passengers as unbelted and hospitalized; they are counted once.
30270-14702 contains an autonomous impact followed by a manual-driving impact; the injured operator is counted once and the narrative does not specify which impact caused the injury.
30610-14090 states the operator disengaged autonomy before contact; this remains in the selected ledger because engagement was verified within the reporting window.
30270-14618 has a moderate injury severity field but its narrative describes minor alleged injuries. Do not silently resolve that discrepancy.
30270-14296 mistakenly refers to SUV-to-SUV contact in its narrative; the summary preserves uncertainty about the stated impact.
The Santa Monica NTSB item is a corroborating account of report 30270-13850, not an additional casualty.
